name: pentacoxian/qwen-qsa-llama.cpp
title: Qwen Sparse Attention holds 185 tok/s at 255K context
summary: On one gaming GPU at 255K context, Qwen3.8-27B with Qwen Sparse Attention held 185 tok/s decode and 2,882 tok/s prompt read, versus 82 and 1,117 on stock llama.cpp, in about 23.5 GB of VRAM. A Hermes Agent run over the full Hermes docs scored 23 of 24 on the QSA build and 21 of 24 on the dense build.

appearances.summary: On one gaming GPU, a Qwen3.8-27B Qwen Sparse Attention build held 185 tokens per second at 255K context, versus 82 on stock llama.cpp, and read the prompt at 2,882 versus 1,117 tokens per second. With the Hermes docs in context, Hermes Agent answered 23 of 24 questions on the sparse build and 21 of 24 on the dense one, using about 23.5 GB of VRAM.
